ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on the distal tips and the continuous trailing edge border.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke regions are solid white; dark focal spots are distributed across both lobes. A prominent brownish-tan staining region is mapped to the lower-central and lower-left medial sectors. Black pigmentation forms a 10-30 pixel wide band along the trailing edge, widening significantly at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 60 degrees; bounding-box depth is significant, extending approximately 1/6th into the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the entire trailing edge boundary; peaks and valleys range from 3 to 12 pixel amplitudes, particularly dense on the outer halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory originating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex curve reaching the distal points; symmetric lateral extension.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 7 circular dark-intensity clusters (rosettes) distributed as follows: three on the left lobe (medial) and four on the right lobe (mid-to-distal), consistent with barnacle-related scarring patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent brownish-tan discoloration/staining localized in the mid-lower central region; numerous dark circular focal scars are visible on the white ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of high-intensity white ventral surface with specific dark-intensity spot distribution and central tan staining.
